headword: {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}
reading: せいりょういんりょうすい

definitions.explanation: A legal and commercial term for non-alcoholic drinks other than milk and dairy beverages. Includes sodas, juices, sports drinks, tea, and water. Commonly seen on vending machines and product labels in Japan.

examples.japanese: {自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}で{清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a soft drink from the vending machine.

examples.japanese: {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}の{飲|の}み{過|す}ぎは{体|からだ}に{良|よ}くない。
examples.english: Drinking too many soft drinks is not good for your health.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}の{売|う}り{上|あ}げが{大|おお}きく{伸|の}びる{時期|じき}だ。
examples.english: Summer is a time when soft drink sales increase significantly.

notes:
USAGE:
This is the official regulatory term defined by the Food Sanitation Act ({食品衛生法|しょくひんえいせいほう}). In everyday conversation, people are more likely to say ジュース or {飲|の}み{物|もの}. The formal term appears on product labels, in news reports, and in legal/business contexts.

- {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}の{市場|しじょう} (soft drink market)
- {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}の{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき} (beverage vending machine)
